title: Optimized Causal Gain from Exact Dose Clamps in Rare-Dose Regions
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field; paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4 and no bounded same-scope field lift.
gap_reasons: The delivered statements establish matched absolute-risk, threshold-location, and regret rates only for a tightly localized, no-covariate, one-time randomized clamp class with known smoothness, thinning, localization, and curvature constants.

The framing overstates the honest-length result as matched throughout the admissible domain: the converse in thm:minimax-gain is stated only along deterministic sequences t_n tending to zero, yet prop:fixed-localization-reduction also attributes an optimal honest-length order for fixed positive t to that theorem.

The narrow model, limited theorem-level comparison with the closest literature, and absence of an application demonstrating relevance to the cited lmtp workflow constrain the leading-journal score despite the matched theoretical frontier.

[D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: D-1/D0 developed a bounded-outcome threshold-clamp frontier with matched optimal-gain risk, threshold-location and regret rates, a four-block upper construction, and Bernoulli lower-bound subclasses. D0.5 math review passed, but the general referee judged the delivered localized randomized model subfield (score ceiling 6.5 versus the field bar 7.4), with no same-scope repair. The fixed-positive-t honest-length attribution needs correction if this result is reused; a field-level successor would need materially broader causal scope or a validating LMTP application.
tldr: On the admissible domain \(t\in\mathcal T_{\mathrm{adm}}\), the causal exact-clamp gain for outcomes in \([0,1]\) is identified by an observed conditional-mean contrast and is maximized at the regression mode. The explicit measurable four-block estimator and interval use only conditionally centered bounded residuals and attain the optimized-gain and uniformly honest expected-length order \(R=\min\{S,U+D\}\), matched by Bernoulli outcome-contrast and compensated-density experiments that form a subclass of the enlarged model. Threshold location and regret retain the matched frontiers \(\ell\) and \(\rho\). Relative threshold error and regret can vanish while relative gain risk and honest length do not exactly when \(\kappa>(\beta+2)/(\beta-2)\).
gap: Modified-treatment-policy theory identifies a user-specified intervention, passive-design optimization studies a regression extremum, and the banked fixed-clamp-mean result retains the natural-course mean. No inspected result works on a demonstrably nonempty shrinking localization class and gives the exact-clamp gain frontier in which common regression level cancels while unknown rare-dose mass remains first order.
fill: The paper certifies class nonemptiness, proves the causal observed-regression representation, derives gain geometry, specifies same-class Bernoulli and compensated-density lower experiments, targets the matched minimax and honest-length modulus with an explicit measurable procedure, adds the prespecified-threshold gain corollary, and characterizes the admissible smoothness--thinning sequences where relative selection succeeds without relative gain inference.
